subject: ggsave no longer saves arrangeGrob output

messages.author: ff42271ef6191bca
messages.subject: ggsave no longer saves arrangeGrob output
parts:
I extensively use ggsave to save plots created with ggplot and arranged with arrangeGrob.
After upgrading to gridExtra 2.0.0 and ggplot 1.0.1 this does no longer work:

p <- arrangeGrob(qplot(1,1), textGrob("test"))
grid.draw(p) # interactive device works
ggsave("saving.pdf", p) # gives the error: "plot should be a ggplot2 plot"

Are these packages no longer compatible?


Thanks,
Herbert

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: ggsave no longer saves arrangeGrob output
parts:
I initially had the same issues, but with an update to the bleeding edge it was fine:

require(devtools)
install_github("hadley/ggplot2")

On Thu, Jul 23, 2015 at 11:38 AM, Herbert Jägle <jae...@eye-regensburg.de> wrote:
p <- arrangeGrob(qplot(1,1), textGrob("test")) grid.draw(p) # interactive device works ggsave("saving.pdf", p)
